name: AIMarket24
tagline: Marketplace for ready-to-use AI agents, n8n workflows and prompt packs
description: AIMarket24 is a marketplace where independent creators sell ready-to-use AI agents, n8n and Make workflows, chatbots, prompt packs and small AI tools, and where buyers can find automations that actually run on their own data. Each listing states what goes in, what comes out, which accounts and API keys it needs and how long setup takes. Listings can carry an audit badge linking to a public audit report. Creators list for free and get paid through Stripe. Available in English and German.
